---
title: Static removal of undeclared groups by the state
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  docx: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    state: "-veil,-extra"
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ["MKKEEPPLAIN", "MKKEEPOTHER"]
        - ["MKGONEDEFAULT", "MKGONEEXTRA", "veil", "group="]
    docx:
      ensureDocxRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ["MKGONEDEFAULT", "MKGONEEXTRA", "veil"]
---

## Section

Plain text MKKEEPPLAIN.

::: {.veil}

Div text MKGONEDEFAULT.

:::

::: {.veil group="extra"}

Div text MKGONEEXTRA.

:::

::: {.veil group="other"}

Div text MKKEEPOTHER.

:::
